comparison.label: Most recent 10 AM before the overnight October 29 update

changes: The extended stair flight is graded from the actual first tread rather than the nominal lower terrace, eliminating the 0.518 metre impassable join
Eleven extended lower treads limit the join and each rise to less than 0.25 metres; existing building collision is retained
Continuous textured ground backing closes the small sky gap beside the neighboring stairs
One coherent world-space water shader replaces stacked periodic ripple and shoreline bands; low river water has irregular moving surface detail
Legacy gate combat-smoke emission and old fixed foam points are removed; sluice spray uses an additive material without dark droplets
Cascade reflection sources are relinked to their actual upper and lower pools; water effects do not reflect into themselves and fill-time reflection planes match the sampled level
Opening the full-width gate retains the propagating river release, connected falls and downstream filling; foam and surface texture move downstream

The title changelog compares the current game with the GitHub build verified live at 10 AM Eastern on October 28, including materials, voices and sound, atlas, tutorials, combat, saves and runtime preparation

transcription.scope: Ten new coached-combat narrator performances; all selected words independently transcribed. Original 282 recordings retain their previous verification.
